info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Wholesale Trading By Param1-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Quote Management API allows users to access detailed information about wholesale trading quotes based on specified parameters. This endpoint facilitates efficient retrieval of trading data, enabling users to make informed decisions in their trading operations. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, trading platforms, and analysts seeking to monitor market trends. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their trading strategies and improve operational efficiency.

get.summary: Fetch the quote management details for a specified resource.
get.description: This endpoint retrieves the management details of a specific quote within the wholesale trading context. Use this API to access detailed information about the quote, including pricing, terms, and other relevant metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve a quote for the specified wholesale trading operation. Make sure to provide the required parameters as per the schema to ensure successful retrieval.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested quote details.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Request.title: Get Quote Management Request Body
GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation in the quote management system for wholesale trading. It currently supports a string format.

tradingBookId.description: Unique identifier for the trading book.

side.description: The side of the trade, e.g., 'buy' or 'sell'.

quantity.description: Quantity of the instrument being traded.

limitPrice.description: Object containing the limit price details for the trade.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Object containing metadata related to the response.

GetWholesaleTradingByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for retrieving quote management operations in wholesale trading.

value.description: The monetary value of the limit price.

currency.description: The currency code for the limit price, e.g., 'USD'.

LimitPrice.description: Schema representing the limit price details for a trade.

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for tracking related requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Schema representing additional metadata for the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request, providing context for operational logging.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes the Bearer authentication method, where a token is provided in the header of the request. The token format must be JSON Web Token (JWT), ensuring secure and verifiable exchanges of information.
